notes: Rule: 'For a data item described with a LOCALE phrase, if a locale-name is specified, locale category LC_MONETARY in that locale is used for editing and de-editing of the data item. If a locale-name is not specified, category LC_MONETARY in the locale current at the time of editing or de-editing is used.' (cite.py --check 14.6.6 -> OK, rule 6). CobolLocaleEdit resolves the named-else-current LC_MONETARY locale AT EACH edit and de-edit (MonetaryFacts). Golden conformance:cases/13.18.40-PICTURE/pb64t6_picture_locale_smoke (hand-derived) pins both halves: P (LOCALE IS US) edits/de-edits under en-US, Q (bare LOCALE) under the current locale.
